# Part C — Decision memo

*Envelope generated by `make partc` from `ablation, adversarial, analysis, bench, corpus_stats, partc, sample_manifest`.
Commit `7b41b1a184acceb2e20bb19a2480a64ef02b24dc-dirty`.*

Paths on the table: **(a)** SFT on synthetic "casualized" pairs, **(b)** a
small inference-time rewriter after the main model, **(c)** prompt engineering
only.

## Assumptions

Stated constraints: 1× A100-80GB for 2 weeks;
1 native-speaker reviewer covering
2 of 6 target languages
at 10 h/week; review launches in
3 weeks; no external API budget.

Estimates I am supplying, each challengeable: reviewer throughput
80 items/h; 15000 SFT pairs;
4 sentences per response;
3 epochs; LoRA throughput between
3000 and 6000 tokens/s.

**No external API budget** means synthetic pairs cannot come from a frontier
API; they must be generated by our own model on the same A100 that trains it.

## Arithmetic

### Human evaluation capacity

| quantity | value |
|---|---|
| reviewer-hours over the project | 20 |
| items at the stated rate | 1600 |
| items per covered language | 800 |
| items per language if split evenly across all targets | 266 |
| languages with zero native-speaker coverage | 4 |

Uncovered: ben, mar, tam, tel.

### Training cost

| quantity | value |
|---|---|
| measured tokens per response (Indic mean, Indic-aware tokenizer) | 119.0 |
| training tokens (15000 pairs × 3 epochs) | 5355089 |
| GPU-hours at the higher throughput estimate | 0.25 |
| GPU-hours at the lower throughput estimate | 0.50 |
| GPU-hours available | 336 |
| utilisation at the lower estimate | 0.00148 |

Sensitivity — GPU-hours at the lower throughput estimate, by dataset size:
5000 pairs → 0.17 h; 15000 pairs → 0.50 h; 50000 pairs → 1.65 h.

### Serving cost of path (b)

Measured output goodput is 200.92 tok/s (B3, batch
24). A rewriter regenerates the whole response, so it adds a
second pass over the same output-token count: 100.46 tok/s
if the rewriter costs the same per token, on the same hardware and batch.
